feature_name: TSConfig Diff Preview in Astro Add
description: Implement a feature that displays a preview of the tsconfig changes before the user confirms adding an integration. Show the computed diff between the current tsconfig and the modified version, then present the confirmation prompt.
functional_requirements: Calculate the diff between the current tsconfig.json and the version after the integration would be added
Display this diff clearly to the user in the CLI before asking for confirmation
Maintain the existing confirmation flow where the user can accept or reject the changes
Ensure the diff preview works for all integration types supported by astro add
